description: a quieter downtown block that narrows as the buildings crowd closer. the sidewalk buckles in patches, telephone poles leaning at odd angles. a few vacant lots sit dark between storefronts, chain-link fence sagging. one streetlight is out and nobody's fixed it. the air smells of old brick, cold dumpster and a thread of wet earth. the taco bell's buzzing sign is the brightest thing on the block.

environment.noise: distant traffic, the taco bell sign buzzing

name: Elm Street

exits.description: glass double doors with a push bar, streaked with a hundred handprints. a taped paper sign reads COME BACK TOMORROW in marker, already ignored by everyone.
